summary: This Form 6-K filed by Fury Gold Mines Ltd. reports a precautionary evacuation of its Eau Claire camp in Quebec due to a nearby wildfire. All personnel were safely evacuated with no injuries, and exploration/drilling activities are temporarily suspended. The company does not currently expect a material impact on its Phase 2 drill program. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation corporate events are involved. This is a routine operational update filed as a foreign private issuer report under Form 6-K.
